scoring_justification: Recompute keff and spurious mode presence from the agent's CSVs; compare summary.json against recomputed values and paper gold. This is a T1 recompute because all headline quantities can be derived deterministically from the raw keff vs frequency data.

hidden_assets.purpose: Target keff for PT2b and spurious mode expectations.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figures 12 and 13 and text: PT2b has keff ~40%, PT2a has multiple spurious modes, PT2b is clean.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported values and physical reasoning. The target keff of 0.40 matches the paper's around 40% statement. Spurious expectations match the paper's figures.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published results, not invented values.

outputs.description: Modal analysis results for PT2a design: eigenfrequencies and effective electromechanical coupling coefficient.
Modal analysis results for PT2b design: eigenfrequencies and effective electromechanical coupling coefficient.

Summary of spurious mode presence and key parameters for PT2b. The checker will compare the effective coupling coefficient and spurious mode flags against reference values derived from the paper's figures.

output_contract.notes: The checker reads the CSV files and recomputes the effective coupling coefficient and spurious mode presence; it then compares the summary's Boolean flags and keff to hidden gold values (paper's reported results) with appropriate tolerances. The keff target uses threshold_or_better policy (higher keff is better).
